correctness.rationale: Using the stationary occupation identity n(l)=(l+beta*rho*q(l))/(zeta+1-l+r(l)), integration gives rho=I/(1-beta*J), beta*J0<1 and a positive exact two-component mixture. The endpoint q(l)=O((1-l)^alpha) implies dominated convergence for J. With s=log(1/u), I is an integral against (1+c*s^theta+exp(s-L))^(-1), whose comparison establishes divergence at theta<=1, finiteness for theta>1, and correct L, L/(1+c), L^(1-theta)/(c(1-theta)) and log L/c asymptotics. Ratios of restricted s-interval integrals prove beta/uniform gap limits and a nested logarithm at theta=1. Independent numerical integration verifies the theta=0 exact elementary case and several other regimes; it is not a proof of asymptotics.
